edges.notes: AlmaLinux ships Linux kernel packages for supported architectures as part of the distribution.
AlmaLinux on standard ports uses glibc as the C library alongside the dynamic linker.
systemd is the default init and service manager on AlmaLinux releases per project documentation themes.
AlmaLinux services are expressed as systemd unit files and drop-ins on default systemd installs.
AlmaLinux userland binaries and shared libraries are ELF on typical Linux targets.
GCC toolchain packages participate in AlmaLinux development and RPM build flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard AlmaLinux RPM build and link flows.
g++-built packages link GNU libstdc++ above glibc on typical AlmaLinux GNU/Linux flows.
Clang/LLVM packages may be installed from AlmaLinux repositories where offered.
Official almalinux OCI images are common glibc-based bases; Docker pulls and runs them like other Linux images.
CRI/containerd nodes run AlmaLinux-based workload images pulled as OCI artifacts.
AlmaLinux is a common node OS choice for on-prem Kubernetes clusters seeking RHEL-compatible glibc userlands.
AlmaLinux bases are packaged as OCI image rootfs layers conforming to OCI image layout conventions.
Substitutable Linux distribution defaults for containers and servers (glibc/systemd vs musl/OpenRC field patterns).
Substitutable community RHEL-compatible rebuild distributions in many server and cloud footprints.
Substitutable community RHEL-compatible rebuild distributions; CentOS Linux legacy EOL vs AlmaLinux active maintenance.
